metadata.title: ICCS Assessment Framework International Civic and Citizenship Education Study Assessment Framework

survey_design.weight_fields_interpretation: This document is an assessment framework for ICCS and does not report an empirical student analysis with an analytic sample. It therefore does not specify the use of complex survey weights (e.g., student/sampling weights or replicate weights) or any weight variable names. For any later empirical ICCS cycle analysis using the ICCS micro-data, analysts should apply the ICCS sampling weights and replicate weights provided in the international database to account for the clustered, stratified design. The framework focuses on domain definitions, contextual variables, and instrument/test booklet design rather than on weighted estimation results.

data.handling_not_reported_explanation: Plausible values handling is not applicable because this is a framework document describing assessment domains, contextual frameworks, and instrument/test booklet design, not an empirical study predicting or scaling student outcomes. Missing-data handling is not reported because no analytic dataset, missingness mechanism, or imputation/deletion strategy is evaluated in this document. As a result, there is no basis to extract PV or missing-data procedures from results tables or methods for an ML pipeline.

sample_details.sample_filtering_criteria: Used the full available sample for the specified countries.

data.outcome_summary: This ICCS assessment framework specifies how civic and citizenship education is operationalized for large-scale measurement, including the structure of the civic and citizenship framework and the contextual framework. It defines content domains (civic and citizenship content), affective-behavioral domains, and cognitive domains, and describes how items are mapped to these domains. The document also outlines assessment design elements such as the ICCS instruments, test booklet design, item types, and how contextual scales are reported. Because it is a framework rather than an empirical analysis, it does not provide model performance metrics, benchmarks, or predictive results. Consequently, it should be used to understand what constructs ICCS measures and how instruments are organized, not to infer effects of predictors on student outcomes.
data.null_fields_interpretation: This extraction is sparse because the provided text is a framework/technical description of ICCS assessment structure rather than an empirical paper with an analytic sample, PV/missing-data procedures, or ML model training/evaluation. The absence of reported sample sizes, countries, and performance metrics is consistent with a documentation role: the document defines domains, contextual variables, and instrument/test design. Therefore, main findings and confounder/predictor lists are intentionally empty.
